description: Free. Read a target package back (for file targets, from an uploaded file) as a fragment and reconcile it. Tool data never overwrites the model: it becomes a proposal like any agent's.

file.description: For file targets: the edited .sysml, .xmi or .mdzip (base64).

model_id.description: A saved model id (m_ followed by 24 hex digits), as the studio and /v1/repos list them.

package.description: The target package exported to (default: the subsystem's latest export to this target).

subsystem_id.description: Qualified name of a package or definition, e.g. "L4Robotaxi::NetworkSwitch".

name: mbe_import_from
title: Import from a target
